inspection.method: One CPU ffmpeg raw RGB decode with source local presentation PTS, all91 sequential frames visually inspected on6 contact sheets; full-resolution frames0,8,12,16,20,24,28,32 also inspected.
inspection.coordinateMethod: Manually located visible-part anchor regions with linear interpolation only between anchors within an explicit visible segment. The exact incoming raw RGB frame must match its checked PTS hash; no prediction outside the91 decoded pins.
inspection.annotationRegionReview: All29 previously marked frame regions inspected on3 additional contact sheets. Cart frames25–27 were withheld after drift during the fast pan; the other regions identify visible object parts. Still-frame inspection only; full encoded motion remains pending.

timeBase.ptsAuthority: Decoded local presentation PTS in the bound source file
timeBase.cadence: Caller may repeat the same original30fps source frame in a60fps master at1x, retaining its original PTS. No source60fps claim, optical interpolation, extra hold or loop.

drawing.kind: Editorial object-identification guides; no detector, confidence, segmentation, commercial collision boundary or measured game values
drawing.sourceFit: Full16:9 within layout actualGameplay viewport; no crop or nonuniform stretch

visibilitySegments.cartHiddenReason: Hide when right weapon UI/edge clips the chosen visible cart-front region; later close cart and foreground weapon make an unnecessary full outline misleading.
visibilitySegments.personHiddenReason: Hide during top-edge head/upper-body clipping, then at left-edge exit. Do not join a contour through the foreground or invent hidden limbs.
